proposal_rationale: Read the complete captured route/evaluation payloads and continued-search feedback. Two of three accepted candidate evaluations are spent; choose this untried joint tuple for the final slot. Baseline: cell_area_um2=161954, setup_slack_ns=0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.114491, zero electrical violations, physical_qualified=true, measurement_qualified=true, rank_eligible=true and Q=1.0 at period_ps=10526. Candidate 1 used both actions at utilization=40,density=0.55,abc_area=0,repair_margin=0: cell_area_um2=160081, setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439, hold_slack_ns=0.0945523, zero electrical violations, failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Candidate 2 used width reduction alone at those physical settings: cell_area_um2=161973, setup_slack_ns=0.105414, hold_slack_ns=0.122652, electrical_violations={max_slew:16,max_cap:6,max_fanout:0}, failure_classes=[electrical], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Both have empty energy_j and estimated_power_w, so neither has a measured qualified Q. The baseline remains the incumbent. Preserve candidate 2 actions and physical settings except increase repair_margin from 0 to the allowed maximum 20, targeting its observed electrical failure while retaining its measured positive timing margins as evidence for the starting point. Violation magnitudes and failing paths are absent, so 20 is a final-slot guardband choice, not a proven sufficient repair or timing prediction. Keep abc_area=0 given limited setup margin; retain utilization and density to avoid adding an unmeasured placement change. The exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension preserves the cycle contract and may reduce switched arithmetic capacitance, but candidate 2 measured no cell-area saving and synthesis may already remove redundant width. Operand isolation remains disabled because the combined-action experiment failed timing; the history does not prove causation, and potential isolation energy savings are forgone. Repair buffering/sizing can raise cell area and energy or alter setup/hold, so electrical closure alone cannot establish improvement. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-07,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-06,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-06). Count standard-cell area, not empty floorplan or die area. Require protected evaluation to report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, energy_j and estimated_power_w for DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, physical_manifest and execution/postprocess/search costs. Compare qualified Q with 1.0 and threshold 0.98; retain the best qualified result plus every failure and cost. Recorded physical_wall_seconds are 3614.690173311974 and 4226.930922063009 for candidates 1 and 2; postprocess_wall_seconds are 4.169996827840805e-07 and 4.0902523323893547e-07, with no postprocessing commands. Their elapsed_search_seconds are 3698.313130289025 and 8011.624283344019 and include EDA execution; they do not establish exhaustion of the separate shared 1200-second agent budget. Only the protected tool may apply actions or run EDA; this proposal claims no new measurement. Energy scope remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, without SDF-delay/glitch or silicon-energy claims.
